experiment.scope: Native CDAC ref MOS; ideal capacitors and surroundings. Same external clock and sampling 50% midpoint/falling edge.

leakage.charge_balance: Top error = initial top error + sum C_i/Ctotal * (bottom rail error now - at sample close); compare against measured top error.
leakage.current_scope: External macro terminal totals include conduction, junction, gate and displacement. No microscopic mechanism partition assumed.
leakage.export: All native points in current_export_native_windows_s; elsewhere >=100ps display sampling. Metrics use all native points.
leakage.sign_convention: enters numbered device port; MOS 1/2/3/4 = D/G/S/B

measurement_revision.settling_end: next DAC update command from native valid crossing plus frozen SAR 50ps capture +100ps update; deadline remains 2ns after own gate 50%

native_state.thread_log: Multithreading is disabled due to the size of the design being too small.

power_note: Signed source energy includes returned energy; gate positive energy is an ideal-drive load measure, not physical digital-driver power. No imposed module power pass limit.
scope: L60 native reference MOS / ideal caps and surrounding blocks; fixed0..0.9V input/reference, logic and PMOS body follow VDD; short PVT screen only.
